title: Closed base change for integral direct images of lisse continuous modules
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its norm topology, and an algebraic closure $\Omega\supset E$ with its extended norm topology. For $F=E$ or $\Omega$, let $C_F(Q)=C(Q,F)$ on all profinite sets, using all continuous functions [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring], and put $C_{F,X}=p_X^*C_F$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Work with internal modules, ordinary unbounded derived categories and K-injective total right derived direct images on small pro-etale sites [sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Lisse means pro-etale locally finite free [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module]. All sites, parameter sets and resolutions lie in compatible coefficient universes.

Let $q:X\to U$ be an integral morphism of affine $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and let $s:Z\hookrightarrow U$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Put $X_Z=X\times_U Z$, with $h:X_Z\to X$ and $q_Z:X_Z\to Z$. For a finite-rank lisse $C_{F,X}$-module $\mathcal L$, the canonical derived exchange is an isomorphism
$$\beta_{q,s,\mathcal L}:s^*Rq_*(\mathcal L[0])\xrightarrow{\sim}R(q_Z)_*(h^*\mathcal L[0]).$$
The map is the adjunct under $q_Z^*\dashv R(q_Z)_*$ of $q_Z^*s^*Rq_*\mathcal L\cong h^*q^*Rq_*\mathcal L\xrightarrow{h^*\varepsilon}\,h^*\mathcal L$, with the canonical coefficient and pullback-composition identifications. It is natural in maps of lisse modules, in isomorphisms of the cartesian square, and in pro-etale base change of $U$; these naturalities also hold after any further profinite parametrization $U[Q]\to U$ [def-sfb-profinite-test-objects]. For an $E$-module and its ordinary scalar extension to $\Omega$, these exchange maps commute, after scalar restriction, with the actual map $x\mapsto1\otimes x$. No exactness of $q_*$ on arbitrary pro-etale sheaves and no scalar-extension/direct-image isomorphism is asserted.

proof.text: Set $\Lambda=C_F$, $U=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $Z=\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$ and $X=\operatorname{Spec}B$. By [lem-sfb-closed-lifted-test-isomorphism-criterion], the closed lifts $W=v(V)=\operatorname{Spec}C$ of its conservative family of tests $V$ are w-contractible, satisfy $V=W\times_U Z$, and have $(C,IC)$ henselian. The input $K=\mathcal L[0]$ is bounded below, as required by that criterion.

proof.text: For each test put $D=B\otimes_A C$, $T=X\times_U W=\operatorname{Spec}D$ and $T_0=X\times_U V=\operatorname{Spec}(D/ID)$. Apply [lem-sfb-integral-henselian-lisse-section-rigidity] to the integral $A$-algebra $B$, the lifted ring $C$, the ideal $I$, and $L=\mathcal L$. It gives the actual unit-induced isomorphism $R\Gamma(T,\mathcal L|_T[0])\to R\Gamma(T_0,\mathcal L|_{T_0}[0])$. Its arbitrary-condensed-ring hypothesis applies to both all-continuous coefficient rings, including incomplete $\Omega$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent assembly of closed lifted-test criterion and integral henselian lisse section rigidity; original seven arguments retained in the two statement-only tasks.

proof.text: The restriction-isomorphism hypothesis of [lem-sfb-closed-lifted-test-isomorphism-criterion] therefore holds on every test. Its conclusion makes exactly the counit-adjunct $\beta_{q,s,\mathcal L}$ an isomorphism in the ordinary unbounded derived category. Its coherence clauses give naturality in lisse-module maps, square isomorphisms and pro-etale base change, including on entire objects $U[Q]$ and further profinite parametrizations. For $C_E\to C_\Omega$, ordinary scalar extension of a finite free basis is a finite free basis, so the extended module is lisse. Apply the same criterion\'s coefficient-map clause to the actual unit $x\mapsto1\otimes x$. This is the asserted compatibility after scalar restriction, using the canonical right-derived coefficient comparisons without assuming them invertible.
